name: banking-churn-analytics
description: cmd. Churn Modeling & Decision Engine: Calibrated Customer Risk & Churn Analytics Platform

scripts.dev:ml: cd ml-service && (test -f venv/bin/python3 && ./venv/bin/python3 -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 || python3 -m uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000)
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "ML,BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "yellow.bold,blue.bold,green.bold" "npm run dev:ml" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.train: cd ml-service && (test -f venv/bin/python3 && ./venv/bin/python3 training/train.py || python3 training/train.py)
scripts.test:ml: cd ml-service && (test -f venv/bin/python3 && ./venv/bin/python3 -m pytest tests/ -v || python3 -m pytest tests/ -v)
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:ml
